description: A seated man in a red and gold patterned tunic and a gold-banded headdress with white and black feathers raises a gold axe-scepter. He sits on a silver and gold litter carried on poles by bearers, surrounded by a crowd of warriors with spears, shields and raised fists. Behind them are stone terraces and walls, steep green mountains, and a misty sunlit sky. The image is a painterly scene with no visible text, no border, and no blood.
